messages:
sam_customer: Promo code PROMO-RED-TRIAL-2026 shows success in the UI and I got a confirmation email, but our org balance is still 0. Org: acme-corp (org_id: org_0a1b2c). Redeemed via SSO (Google) at ~2026-03-15 08:02 UTC. Web checkout returned 200 and a green check. Screenshot sent in DM. Can someone check why ledger didn't post?

maria_support: Sorry about that, @sam_customer. Can you paste the request id from the browser network tab or the claim id from the confirmation email? Also, was this redeemed through SSO or direct login?

sam_customer: Redeemed via SSO. Claim id in the email is 9f8a7c. Happy to DM org id if needed.

maria_support: thx — escalating to billing. @billing-bot can you pull ingest trace for claim_id=9f8a7c and org_id=org_0a1b2c?

billing-bot: voucher-ingest: received claim=9f8a7c provider=webflow user=sam@acme.com ack=200 processing -> ledger_write=false reason=NO_LINKED_BILLING_ACCOUNT trace=trc_04f2

lena_engineer: quick note — our ingest pipeline expects a billing_account mapping for SSO-created tenants. If the mapping is missing, current behavior is to ack the webhook but skip ledger write. Looks like org_0a1b2c has billing_account_id=NULL.

maria_support: @sam_customer can you check your Billing page and confirm whether there is a billing account attached to the org? It should show the billing account name or "Add billing account".

sam_customer: I see Billing: "Account linked: Acme Corp Billing (acct_9zz)" in the UI. So it looks linked on the portal.

lena_engineer: odd — UI shows link but datastore mapping might not have replicated. Pulling tenant mapping now.

lena_engineer: log excerpt:
```
ingest-service[stderr]: WARN claim=9f8a7c org=org_0a1b2c tenant_mapper.go:142 mapping_status=NOT_FOUND
billing-connector: lookup billing_account for tenant returned null
```

ops_jay: I think this is a replication/race during SSO onboarding where the billing mapping record didn't make it into the accounting DB before the webhook arrived. I'll run a reconciliation for org_0a1b2c and backfill mapping.

maria_support: @sam_customer we've opened an internal ticket to manually apply the promo credit while we fix the replication issue. Can we get authorization to perform a one-off ledger write for your org? Reply with 'authorize' to approve.

sam_customer: authorize — please go ahead, we need the credits for testing.

billing-bot: manual-credit: applying credit amount=500 reason="promo PROMO-RED-TRIAL-2026" actor=maria_support ticket=INC-2026-343 trace=trc_04f2

billing-bot: ledger write success tx=tx_77a3 new_balance=500 remaining_promo=500

maria_support: @sam_customer confirmed — ledger now shows 500 credits applied. Can you refresh the portal and confirm?

sam_customer: Confirmed! Portal shows 500 credits now, and redemption flow looks good. Thanks everyone :partying_face:

maria_support: Closing the Slack thread. Follow-up actions: engineering will add a pre-ack validation to reject/queue claims that lack billing mapping and add an alert so we don't miss these in the future. cc @lena_engineer

lena_engineer: Filing RFC to implement pre-ack check + reconciliation job and alerting on mapping failures. Will post PR with tests."
